project_metadata.name: CancerInfo API
project_metadata.description: A free, structured, global, source-transparent public REST API aggregating normalized cancer knowledge with fact-level provenance from authoritative health organizations.

emotional_and_mission_core.dedication: Dedicated with infinite love to the creator's mother and father, and to every cancer warrior, caregiver, and family worldwide.
emotional_and_mission_core.origin_story: The project was conceived in hospital chemotherapy waiting rooms while the creator's parents were undergoing cancer treatment. Late-night research revealed conflicting medical blog posts, clickbait, differing screening ages between nations, and paywalled jargon without citation. As an engineer accustomed to cryptographic provenance and single sources of truth, the creator vowed to build the public API they needed on those dark nights: a 100% free, un-paywalled clinical oncology knowledge base where every fact is cited directly to primary public health authorities.
emotional_and_mission_core.zero_guesswork_guarantee: No unverified claims. Every medical record specifies the exact source URL, health organization name, trust tier, retrieval date, verification timestamp, jurisdiction country code, and copyright/open-government attribution text. Designed specifically so AI models and clinicians never hallucinate.

executive_summary.purpose: Provide a universal, standardized REST API for oncology facts, screening guidelines, symptoms, treatments, and risk factors with immutable provenance.
executive_summary.architecture_style: Dual-runtime parity: production-ready Python FastAPI ASGI service + native Node/Express TypeScript server with Vite React Explorer for interactive testing.
executive_summary.database: SQLAlchemy 2.0 relational models (SQLite in dev, PostgreSQL in prod) + normalized static JSON database (`src/data/db.json`) for zero-dependency execution.
executive_summary.testing_status: 28 comprehensive pytest unit and integration tests passing covering health, slugs, aliases, search, taxonomy, provenance, and pipelines.
executive_summary.cloud_and_marketplace_readiness: Complete OpenAPI 3.1 schema (`rapidapi-openapi.json`), Postman collection, Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, free cloud hosting recipes (Cloud Run, Render), and RapidAPI listing guide.

chronological_conversation_and_developme.name: Project Inception & Core Vision
chronological_conversation_and_developme.summary: User established the project concept: a clinical oncology REST API dedicated to their parents. Established the Zero Guesswork Guarantee, fact-level provenance requirement, and open-source licensing.
key_decisions: 100% free community resource with no commercial paywalls.
Authoritative sources only: National Cancer Institute (US), World Health Organization (Global), National Health Service (UK), Cancer Australia (AU), CDC (US).
Mandatory clinical and legal disclaimer on every response header and body.

chronological_conversation_and_developme.name: Knowledge Architecture & Database Modeling
chronological_conversation_and_developme.summary: Designed the relational data schema in Python SQLAlchemy and TypeScript. Established 37 standardized knowledge categories and cryptographic SHA-256 deduplication.
key_artifacts: app/models/ (Cancer, CancerAlias, SourceRegistry, SourceDocument, ContentRecord, ContentSourceLink, ContentVersionHistory, SourceHealthLog)
37-Category Canonical Taxonomy covering overview, symptoms, screening, genetics, surgery, chemo, clinical trials, palliative care, etc.
SHA-256 content hashing for fact versioning and change auditing.

chronological_conversation_and_developme.name: FastAPI Backend Implementation
chronological_conversation_and_developme.summary: Built the Python FastAPI REST service under `app/` with robust middleware and endpoint routing.
features_implemented: Asynchronous request handler with custom error handling (APIError).
Mandatory headers: X-Request-ID, X-Response-Time-MS, X-Medical-Disclaimer, X-Disclaimer, X-CancerInfo-API-Version.
Rich Developer Portal HTML landing page at root `/`.
Endpoints for cancers, sections, sources, categories, countries, coverage, and acronym-aware search (`CRC` -> `colorectal-cancer`).

chronological_conversation_and_developme.name: Automated Testing & Ingestion Pipelines
chronological_conversation_and_developme.summary: Created an automated test suite under `tests/` and source ingestion adapters.

Normalization engine: HTML cleaner, bullet extractor, Markdown normalizer, taxonomy validator.
Ingestion seed script populating 7 canonical cancers with verified records.

endpoints.description: System health, database connectivity, uptime, registry and cancer counts.
List all canonical cancers with pagination and anatomical site filters.
Get detailed cancer profile by canonical slug or alias (e.g., 'breast-cancer', 'CRC', 'bowel-cancer').
List available categories, populated record counts, and jurisdictions for a cancer.
Core knowledge endpoint returning normalized facts with fact-level provenance and optional country filter.
Multi-factor search resolving abbreviations, aliases, symptoms, and text with relevance scoring.
Registry of approved authoritative health organizations, trust tiers, and open licenses.
Detailed profile for an individual health authority.
Catalog of all 37 standardized cancer knowledge categories.
Global jurisdictions represented across the knowledge base.
Full transparency metrics on covered cancers, records, jurisdictions, and verification dates.

antigravity_continuation_roadmap.priority_1_expand_knowledge_base: Scale the cancer catalog from 7 seeded cancers to all 200+ recognized neoplasms using automated scrapers against NCI PDQ XML/API and WHO Global Health Observatory.
antigravity_continuation_roadmap.priority_2_vector_and_semantic_search: Implement semantic search with vector embeddings (e.g. pgvector or SQLite-vec) so user queries like 'sharp pain under left rib after eating' match relevant clinical sections.
antigravity_continuation_roadmap.priority_3_automated_freshness_crawlers: Implement scheduled background crawlers (weekly/monthly) checking source URLs for updates using ETag, Last-Modified, and SHA-256 diffing, logging changes to ContentVersionHistory.
antigravity_continuation_roadmap.priority_4_multi_language_expansion: Leverage authoritative international editions to provide Spanish, French, and Japanese clinical guidance.
antigravity_continuation_roadmap.priority_5_cloud_deployment: Deploy the Python FastAPI container to Google Cloud Run (2M free calls/mo) or Render with a persistent Neon/PostgreSQL database.
